description: Check A's break test must apply SLS §3.5's epsilon (TOLERANCE_ATR x Wilder ATR at the break candle) and must still catch a decisive penetration. Found live 2026-09-24: BNBUSDT M15, close 765.23 against a confirmed external low of 765.29 -- a penetration of 0.06 where epsilon was 0.0976 -- flagged as a missing BOS_DOWN for two hourly runs. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/break_tolerance.json

mutations.name: the defect itself: no tolerance, a plain close-beyond-level comparison
mutations.old: eps = TOLERANCE_ATR * atr if atr is not None else Decimal(0)

mutations.name: tolerance so wide that a real break is silenced
mutations.old: eps = TOLERANCE_ATR * atr if atr is not None else Decimal(0)
mutations.new: eps = TOLERANCE_ATR * atr * 100 if atr is not None else Decimal(0)

mutations.name: read the whole window instead of only closes after the level existed
take the oldest confirmed level instead of the most recent
open a gate for every state, including RANGING
count an unconfirmed swing as a level
mutations.old: if swing.kind is kind and swing.index + K_EXTERNAL <= last
